meta.parties: Muttiah Chetty v. Maricar Et Al., Ex Parte Hydroos Lebbe Maricar,Substituted Plaintiff

rules.statement: Section 339 of the Civil Procedure Code enacts substantive law and cannot be waived. The rule it embodies is not a mere rule of arbitrary enactment or convenience, but one resting on solid grounds of principle and equity.
rules.supporting_quote: "The rule embodied in this section is not a mere rule of arbitrary) enactment or of convenience, but one resting on solid grounds of principle and equity."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 339 of the Civil Procedure Code
